seams: This package declares the filter value shape; DC reads it and stores it
Multi-value wire is a repeated f_key parameter; DC writes and parses it
DC's saved and shared views keep their bytes; one value round-trips as today
CRM, RMS, org-admin adopt nothing: density, cut and widths are all off by default
Package sets the three column-width steps; DC picks a step per column, in 3 places
DC shrinks its own header and summary rows; grid gets the new Select all row
